sentences.en: It is whispered that the Prime Minister is critically ill.
"Yes!", he whispered in my ear with his charming voice.
sentences.zh: 他用迷人嗓音在我耳边低语：‘是的！’

sentences.en: "Come back down to earth," she whispered into his ear.
sentences.zh: 她在他耳边轻声说道：‘回到现实吧。’

mnemonic: 联想记忆：whi（看作who，谁）+sper（看作speaker，说话）→谁在小声说话→低语
